Procurement analytics

Turning fragmented ERP records into operating decisions

At Taohuolang, I connected product, supplier, purchasing, invoice, and inventory records to make weekly procurement reporting more trustworthy and useful.

SQLExcelPower BIData qualityReporting

From records to action

Create a reliable data base

I cleaned, reconciled, and joined records from multiple ERP tables before defining reusable reporting measures.

Make inventory risk visible

I built reporting views for inventory aging, sales progress, purchasing spend, price variance, and supplier returns.

Connect reporting to decisions

Trend and comparison analysis supported purchasing and supplier recommendations, including action on targeted excess stock.

Make the work repeatable

I documented metric definitions, source mapping, refresh steps, and maintenance workflows for consistent reuse.

The value came from giving decision makers a reliable path from raw records to a specific purchasing action.
